name: Video Pages
description: Video Pages turns a video you made, or uploaded, into a branded landing page with a public link. The page has a call to action, an optional lead form, and a view and play counter. You can send each contact a personal link that greets them by name.
shortDescription: Turn any video into a branded landing page with a button, a lead form and view analytics.
fullDescription: Video Pages is for putting a video in front of people on a page of its own. You pick a video (one you generated in any studio, an MP4 you upload, or an https link), pick a template, and press 'Create page'. The page opens in an editor with a live preview: you change the headline, the buttons, extra sections, a lead form and the colours, and click any text on the page to edit it. A page starts as a Draft that only you can see. 'Publish' makes it live at a public link of the form /p/<page id> and gives you 'Copy link' and 'Copy embed' buttons. Three tabs sit above the editor: Design, Contacts and Analytics. In Contacts you import a CSV of people and get a personal link for each one, so a headline written as 'Hi {{firstname|there}}' shows each person their own name. Analytics counts views, plays, how many watched to the end, button clicks, likes and leads. You need to be signed in, because pages and contacts are saved to your account.
bestFor: Sending one video to a prospect, a client or a list of leads on a branded page instead of a bare file link: sales outreach, offers, product demos, event invitations and lead capture.
whenToUse: You want a shareable page around a video, with a button and a lead form.
You want to greet each recipient by name or company with a personal link.
You want to see who watched, whether they clicked the button and how many leads came in.
You want an embed code to place the page on another site.
whenToUseAnother: Use Website Builder (#/website-builder) when you need a whole website, not one page around one video.
Use Personalizer (#/personalizer) when you want the same image or design made many times with different names on it.
Use Lead Finder (#/leadfinder) when you still need to find businesses to send the page to.
keyFeatures: Three ways to bring a video: pick one you already made, upload an MP4, or paste an https link.
Many templates, in three groups: Editable landing pages, Page structures and Layouts.
Click-to-edit text on the page, with a side panel to add, remove and reorder sections.
A call-to-action button that plays the video or opens a link, plus extra buttons that can open a calendar, call, text, download a file or scroll to the form.
A lead form whose fields, wording and thank-you message you control.
Personal links from a CSV, with tokens such as {{firstname|there}} and {{company|your team}}.
Rewrite with AI, which changes only the words on the page and can be undone.
Analytics (views, plays, play rate, watched to the end, button clicks, likes, leads) and an optional MailerLite send.

featureExplanations.explanation: Press '+ New page'. Choose a video (the grid under 'Or pick a video you already made', the 'Upload an MP4' box, or a pasted https link and 'Use link'), choose a template, then press 'Create page'. The editor opens with your video in place.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: It is the quickest way to a finished page: the template supplies the layout and sample wording, and you only change what you want.

featureExplanations.explanation: Change the template, headline and subheadline, the accent and highlight colours, the action buttons, a Like button, extra sections, a calendar, a transcript panel, a countdown, header and branding, the call to action, the lead form, social proof and footer, and a privacy notice. Which groups are open depends on the template. 'Preview as' shows the page as a sample person, as one of your contacts, or with no contact.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Everything on the page is edited in one place, and the preview shows the result as you type.

featureExplanations.explanation: 'Save' stores your changes ('Unsaved changes' appears next to it until you do). 'Publish' makes the page live and shows its link; 'Unpublish' takes it back to Draft. While it is a Draft only you can see it.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: You can build and check a page privately, and only share the link when it is ready.

featureExplanations.explanation: Open the Contacts tab and use 'Import CSV' (a file with a name, company or email column, up to 5MB). Each row gets a personal link; 'Copy link' copies it and 'Export CSV with links' gives you the whole list. The list shows whether each person has not viewed the page yet, watched without clicking, or clicked. Personal links only work once the page is published.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: A greeting with the person's own name gets more attention than a generic page, and you can see who actually watched.

featureExplanations.explanation: Open 'Rewrite with AI', choose 'Whole page' or one section, type an instruction, and press 'Rewrite'. You see the proposed changes and press 'Apply' (it shows how many) or 'Discard'; 'Undo last rewrite' restores the earlier text. Only the words are sent and changed: layout, links, images, form fields and settings are never touched, and tokens like {{company}} must survive or the change is refused. It uses your own OpenAI key.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: It lets you retune the tone or the offer quickly without risking the structure of the page.

featureExplanations.explanation: The Analytics tab shows Views, Plays, Play rate, Watched to end, CTA clicks, Likes and Leads. Contacts can also be sent, with their personal link, to a MailerLite group ('Send to MailerLite'), and so can leads from the lead form. You paste your own MailerLite API token, which stays in this browser until you press 'Forget token'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: You can see what is working and put the personal links straight into your own email tool.

howToUse: 1. Sign in, then open Video Pages from the side menu (#/video-pages). 2. Press '+ New page'. 3. Pick a video you made, upload an MP4, or paste an https link and press 'Use link'. 4. Pick a template. 5. Press 'Create page'. 6. In the Design tab, edit the headline, the button, the lead form and any sections; click text on the page to edit it. 7. Press 'Save'. 8. Press 'Publish' and copy the link, or the embed code. 9. For personal links, open Contacts, import a CSV, and copy or export the links. 10. Check the Analytics tab to see views, plays, clicks and leads.
howToSteps: Sign in and open Video Pages from the side menu.
Choose a video: one you made, an uploaded MP4, or a pasted https link.
Choose a template and press 'Create page'.
Edit the page in the Design tab and press 'Save'.
Optional: import contacts in the Contacts tab and share each personal link.
inputs: A video (made in the app, uploaded, or an https link)
Your wording, button and form choices
optionalInputs: A CSV of contacts for personal links
A calendar link, a transcript, a countdown
Your logo, brand name and colours
A MailerLite API token to send contacts and leads
Your OpenAI key for 'Rewrite with AI'
outputs: A landing page at a public link (/p/<page id>) once published
An embed code for the page
Personal links for each imported contact, and a CSV export of them
Lead form submissions and view analytics
Contacts and leads in MailerLite, if you send them
limitations: You must be signed in, and the account connection must be set up; otherwise the studio only shows a message.
Uploaded videos can be up to 100MB. A video that is not already stored permanently is copied when the page is created.
A pasted video link must start with https://.
Only calendar links from Calendly, Cal.com, HubSpot Meetings, TidyCal, YouCanBookMe, SavvyCal, Google, Zcal, Chili Piper, Acuity and Outlook can be embedded.
A contacts CSV can be up to 5MB.
Personal links work only after the page is published.
Deleting a page also deletes its analytics, and its link stops working.
troubleshooting: The studio only shows 'Sign in to create and manage video landing pages': sign in first.
A pasted link is rejected: it must be a full https:// video link.
A calendar link is not embedded: only the listed calendar services are allowed.
Personal links do not open the page: publish the page first.
'Rewrite with AI' returns nothing usable: try a different instruction. The change is refused if it would remove a token such as {{company}}.
Analytics show nothing: publish the page, because views are counted only on a live page.
exampleWorkflows: Generate a product video in Video Studio, press 'Create landing page' on it in the Library, pick a template, add a lead form, publish, and share the link.
Upload an MP4, write the headline as 'Hi {{firstname|there}}, a quick idea for {{company|your team}}', publish, import a CSV of prospects, and send each person their personal link.
relatedStudioGuidance: Use Lead Finder to find the businesses, then Video Pages to give each one a personal link.
Use Website Builder when you need more than one page.
notConfirmed: The exact number of templates in each group was not counted for this guide.
How leads from the form are delivered to you beyond the Contacts list and the MailerLite send was not checked here.
Limits on the number of pages per account were not found in the studio code.
